# czc-v2026.10.28.2 (0.2.19.1)

Brings in upstream sub2api v0.2.19 plus three later upstream commits
(67 commits) while keeping every local customization. New: GPT-6.1 Terra,
Grok account model-catalog diagnostics, DeepSeek cache-hit accounting and a
shorter cooldown for rate-frequency 429s on Chinese Coding Plan accounts.
Gemini, Antigravity, promo codes and batch image generation stay removed.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.28.1

### Billing changes (check before upgrading)

- **`deepseek-v4-pro` is billed at Pro rates again after 2026-09-14.**
  The previous build switched it to Flash rates at 2026-09-14 04:00 UTC.
  DeepSeek kept serving Pro, so the default price card now stays at
  $0.66 input / $1.98 output / $0.022 cache read per million tokens
  (Flash was $0.15 / $0.60 / $0.003). Groups and channels with custom
  pricing are not affected. The local DeepSeek peak-rate rules still apply.
- **DeepSeek cache hits are billed as cache reads.** `prompt_cache_hit_tokens`
  in DeepSeek's OpenAI-compatible usage is now counted as cache-read tokens.
  Before, cache reads were always 0 for DeepSeek and those tokens were billed
  as normal input.
- **GPT-6.1 Terra** default price is 2× the official API price, the same rule
  as GPT-6.x Sol: $2 input / $10 output / $2.50 cache write / $0.10 cache read
  per million tokens, with the 272K long-context ladder (input and cache 2×,
  output 1.5×) and Fast/priority at 2×.
- Model plaza now shows a group's per-model price instead of the image
  fallback tier.

### Models

- New model `gpt-6.1-terra` (reasoning effort `none` to `max`, default
  `medium`), including Codex model listing, alias normalization
  (`openai/gpt-6.1-terra-max` etc.), Anthropic/Chat Completions conversion,
  account whitelist and the API key usage examples.
- The local OpenAI catalog is unchanged otherwise: retired gpt-5.5 / gpt-5.4 /
  gpt-4o entries that upstream still lists are not re-added.

### Grok accounts

- Account edit page shows a model-catalog diagnostics panel: catalog source,
  whether it is trusted, last sync attempt, and how each local mapping
  matches the upstream catalog.
- Manual sync and background observation use the same parsing rules. A
  failed, out-of-order or stale-form update no longer overwrites a good
  catalog snapshot; saving the account form always keeps the latest
  snapshot from the database.
- The raw upstream response model is recorded for native Responses and all
  converted paths, for auditing.

### Gateway

- OpenAI OAuth `/v1/responses` with `stream=false` returns one JSON object,
  also when upstream sends SSE without a `Content-Type`, and for
  `response.incomplete` / `response.cancelled` terminal events.
- Chinese Coding Plan accounts: a 429 whose message is about request
  frequency, while the quota snapshot shows every window below 90%, now uses
  the short default 429 cooldown (default 5 s) instead of pausing the
  account until the 5-hour window resets. Real quota exhaustion is
  unchanged.
- OpenCode forwarding to DeepSeek no longer sends the `developer` role
  (upstream returned 422).
- Image edit uploads: each multipart part may be up to **50 MB** (was 20 MB).
  Larger parts are rejected with an error instead of being silently cut.
- Model list refresh no longer sends duplicate upstream requests on a
  concurrent cold start.
- Claude Code billing fingerprint: upstream's Node.js reference vectors were
  added as tests and pass against the local implementation (no behavior
  change).

### Admin and API

- Very large pagination values return 400 instead of overflowing into a 500.
- Admin protection rule validation errors return 400 instead of 500.
- Saving a channel no longer drops the platform dimensions of
  `web_search_emulation`.

### Not included from upstream

- Gemini: default model list refresh, configurable same-account retries
  (`gateway.max_same_account_retries_gemini`), bound-cache retries,
  `/v1beta/models` mapping changes and `fileData` image billing. Gemini
  protocol support was removed in this fork.
- Antigravity: rejection of malformed non-streaming tool calls.
- These config keys are not added: `gateway.max_account_switches_gemini`,
  `gateway.max_same_account_retries_gemini`,
  `gateway.antigravity_fallback_cooldown_minutes`.

### Dependencies

- `golang.org/x/net` v0.62.0 (GO-2026-6860), with matching `x/crypto`,
  `x/sys`, `x/term`, `x/text` updates.

## VERSION

`0.2.19.1`

## Upgrade guidance

- No database migration. No configuration change is required.
- The API key auth cache snapshot version is unchanged (26).
- Review DeepSeek V4 Pro pricing expectations: users on default pricing pay
  Pro rates again for `deepseek-v4-pro`.

## Compatibility

- Image edit clients that sent parts between 20 MB and 50 MB now succeed;
  parts above 50 MB get an error instead of a truncated upload.
- Non-stream OAuth Responses clients get JSON where some cases previously
  returned SSE text.

Passed (on the merged tree):

- `go build ./...`; `go vet ./...`, `go vet -tags unit ./...`,
  `go vet -tags integration ./...`.
- `go test -count=1 ./...`: all packages pass.
- `go test -count=1 -tags=unit ./...`: all packages pass.

- golangci-lint v2.14.0 (CI version): 0 issues.
- Merged upstream tests adapted to local signatures and passing: Grok
  catalog/diagnostics/audit, OAuth non-stream JSON (#7979), GPT-6.1 Terra,
  CN frequency 429, DeepSeek cache hits, image upload limit, pagination,
  channel web-search merge, Claude fingerprint Node.js vectors.
- Repository: Grok managed keys always come from the locked DB row when

- Frontend: eslint, `vue-tsc --noEmit`, i18n key check, vitest 395 files /

Failed or skipped:

- `codexwire` `TestH2RoundTripOverTCP` failed in 2 of 5 full
  `-tags=integration` runs ("stream closed before response headers"). It
  passes alone (900 runs). Under 16 parallel copies it fails on this build
  (22 of 3200) and also on czc-v2026.10.28.1 (12 of 3200). This is a
  pre-existing, load-sensitive test flake, not caused by this release.
- e2e tests (`-tags=e2e`) were not run.
- GPT-6.1 Terra, the Grok diagnostics panel and the CN frequency 429 path
  were not tested against live upstream accounts before deploy.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.28.1`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.28.2-<UTC timestamp>` created during
this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`. There is no migration, so no
database rollback is needed. After rollback `deepseek-v4-pro` bills at Flash
rates again and `gpt-6.1-terra` is no longer recognized.
